# The Metropolitan Museum of Art

> > The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met) presents 5,000 years of art from around the world through 490,000+ artworks, exhibitions, scholarly resources, and educational programs across The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters.

The Met is one of the world's largest and most comprehensive art museums, featuring specialized curatorial departments, the renowned Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History, Thomas J. Watson Library, and extensive digital collections. The museum serves as both a cultural institution for public visitors and a research center for scholars studying art history, conservation, and global artistic traditions.

## Key Topics

- The Met Collection (490,000+ artworks)
- Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History
- The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters
- Curatorial departments (American Wing, Costume Institute, Robert Lehman Collection)
- Thomas J. Watson Library
- Current and past exhibitions
- Art history scholarship and research
- Museum publications and catalogs
- Conservation and preservation
- Global art collections (South Asia, Ancient Near East, European art)
- Contemporary artists (Helene Schjerfbeck, Jeffrey Gibson)
- Educational programs and resources
- Membership and support opportunities

## Art Collection & Exploration

- [The Met Collection](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection): Browse 490,000+ artworks spanning 5,000 years across museum departments
- [Departments](https://www.metmuseum.org/departments): Overview of Met's curatorial departments and specialized collections
- [Exhibitions](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions): Current and upcoming exhibitions featuring global artists and cultures

## Visitor Information

- [The Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org): Homepage for The Met: 5,000 years of art from around the world
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit): Visitor info for Met Fifth Avenue and Met Cloisters: hours, tickets, access
- [About The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met): Museum overview, history, mission, and institutional information

## Scholarly Resources & Research

- [Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History](https://www.metmuseum.org/essays/timeline-of-art-history): 1,000+ scholarly essays on art history, artists, movements, and themes
- [Libraries and Research Centers](https://www.metmuseum.org/research-centers): Watson Library and specialized research centers with digital collections
- [MetPublications](https://www.metmuseum.org/met-publications): 1,700+ museum publications, catalogs, and guides with free downloads
- [Perspectives](https://www.metmuseum.org/perspectives): Essays, interviews, and stories exploring art, artists, and discoveries

## Support & Opportunities

- [Support](https://www.metmuseum.org/support): Donate, become a member, or support Met programs and conservation efforts
- [Opportunities](https://www.metmuseum.org/opportunities): Career, internship, fellowship, and volunteer opportunities at The Met
- [Press](https://www.metmuseum.org/press): Press room with releases, media resources, and high-res images for media

## Optional

- [Past Exhibitions](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/past): Archive of past exhibitions from The Met's exhibition history
